Rain Likely in Maharashtra? IMD Issues Yellow Alert for District in Vidarbha Region on October 7
By Lokmat Times Desk | Updated: October 7, 2026 12:37 IST2026-10-07T12:37:10+5:302026-10-07T12:37:24+5:30
Mumbai witnessed clear skies on Wednesday morning, with the maximum temperature likely to reach 33.5 degrees Celsius in the afternoon and the minimum around 26 degrees Celsius at night.
The Regional Meteorological Centre (RMC), Mumbai, has issued a yellow alert for thunderstorms accompanied by lightning, light to moderate rainfall and gusty winds (30-40kmph) at isolated places in Gadchiroli district of Vidarbha in Maharashtra on Wednesday, October 7.
Meanwhile, the weather in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region (MMR), including Thane, Raigad, Palghar, is expected to remain dry until October 11, 2026. Strong winds with speeds up to 31 KMPH are likely in Alibag, Colaba, Radhanagri, Baramati, Ambejogai and Chakur.
Mumbai witnessed clear skies on Wednesday morning, with the maximum temperature likely to reach 33.5 degrees Celsius in the afternoon and the minimum around 26 degrees Celsius at night.

Light rain or thundershowers are very likely to occur at isolated places over South Konkan-Goa and South Madhya Maharashtra and
mainly sunny weather conditions are very likely to prevail over North Konkan, North Madhya Maharashtra and Marathwada, according to RMC.
No large change in maximum temperature during the next 24 hours and a gradual rise by 2-3 deg Celsius over northern parts of Maharashtra during the subsequent 3 days. Maximum temperature is likely to remain in the range of 37-39 degrees over parts of interior Maharashtra during 7-10 October 2026. No large change in maximum temperature over the Gujarat region during the next 4-5 days.
As the monsoon has now started its withdrawal, a significant change is being observed in the weather across Maharashtra. Rainfall has taken a break in many parts of the state, while heatwave-like conditions have prevailed as October heat continues across the state.
